subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the security and workflow owners approve these exact third-party action SHA revisions for jobs that handle repository secrets, app tokens, registry credentials, and release publishing?
rationale: The required decision is about trusted code execution at credential-bearing workflow boundaries; it cannot be safely inferred from Dependabot metadata or ordinary CI success.

options.title: Approve verified pins
options.body: Independently verify the upstream revisions and approve the rebased dependency update after required checks refresh.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Leave this grouped bump unmerged until the action revisions can be reviewed by the responsible security and workflow owners.

recommendation.title: Approve verified pins
recommendation.body: Independently verify the upstream revisions and approve the rebased dependency update after required checks refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNERS reviewer for the touched dependency-security workflow surfaces.
